6441	export class AccessorOp extends Operator<AccessorOp> {
6442	  static displayName = 'Accessor'
6443	  static description =
6444	    'A function called for each row of your data and passed to Deck.gl layer properties. The current row is passed as the `d` variable (e.g., `d.population`, `d.properties.color`). Available variables: `d` (current row), `i` (index), `data` (all rows), `op()` (access operators), `sequenceTime` (timeline position), `frame` (current frame), `totalFrames`, `sequence` (timeline metadata). Includes d3, turf, and other utilities.'
6445	  createInputs() {
6446	    return {
6447	      expression: new ExpressionField(),
6448	    }
6449	  }
6450	  createOutputs() {
6451	    return {
6452	      accessor: new FunctionField(),
6453	    }
6454	  }
6455	  execute({ expression }: ExtractProps<typeof this.inputs>): ExtractProps<typeof this.outputs> {
6456	    const fn = fnWithSource(
6457	      [
6458	        'd',
6459	        'i',
6460	        'data',
6461	        'op',
6462	        'sequenceTime',
6463	        'frame',
6464	        'totalFrames',
6465	        'sequence',
6466	        ...Object.keys(freeExports),
6467	      ],
6468	      `return ${expression}`,
6469	      this.id
6470	    )
6471	
6472	    // Subscribe to timeline changes - accessor will get fresh values on each call
6473	    subscribeOpToTimeline(this)
6474	
6475	    // https://deck.gl/docs/developer-guide/using-layers#accessors
6476	    const accessor = (d: unknown, dInfo: { index: number; data: unknown; target: number[] }) => {
6477	      const contextualGetOp = safeOpGetter(this.id)
6478	      // Get fresh timeline values for each accessor call
6479	      const timelineContext = getTimelineContext()
6480	      try {
6481	        return fn(
6482	          d,
6483	          dInfo.index,
6484	          dInfo.data,
6485	          contextualGetOp,
6486	          timelineContext.sequenceTime,
6487	          timelineContext.frame,
6488	          timelineContext.totalFrames,
6489	          timelineContext.sequence,
6490	          ...Object.values(freeExports)
6491	        )
6492	      } catch (_e) {
6493	        // Swallow per-row errors — returning undefined lets deck.gl skip the item
6494	        // rather than crashing the GPU process
6495	        return undefined
6496	      }
6497	    }
6498	
6499	    return { accessor }
6500	  }
